id: \bThe Kanto Grand Festival is going to be held here. Come back later when we are set up.
en: \bThe Kanto Grand Festival is going to be held here.  Come back later when we are set up.
it: \bIl Grand Festival di Kanto si terrà qui.  Torna più tardi, quando avremo finito di allestire.

id: \bButterfree, this is not the time! Calm down.
en: \bButterfree, this is not the time! Calm down.
it: \bButterfree, non è il momento! Calmati.

id: \bI calmed Butterfree down. Just in time for the Grand Festival too.
en: \bI calmed Butterfree down. Just in time for the Grand Festival too.
it: \bSono riuscito a calmare Butterfree. Giusto in tempo per il Grand Festival.

id: \bA word of advice: don't focus on just one type. Try using multiple types to ensure a victory.
en: \bA word of advice: don't focus on just one type. Try using multiple types to ensure a victory.
it: \bUn consiglio: non concentrarti su un solo tipo. Prova a usare tipi diversi per assicurarti la vittoria.

id: \bBrock: Hey \PN! I heard you got eight badges, so I came to support you. You've been doing great advancing through the matches.
en: \bBrock: Hey \PN! I heard you got eight badges, so I came to support you. You've been doing great advancing through the matches.
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN! Ho sentito che hai ottenuto otto medaglie, così sono venuto a sostenerti. Stai andando alla grande in questi incontri.

id: \bIt gets tougher from there, so let me see if you're ready for your next round.
en: \bIt gets tougher from there, so let me see if you're ready for your next round.
it: \bDa qui in poi si fa più dura, quindi vediamo se sei pronto per il prossimo turno.

id: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
en: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
it: \bBrock: Gran bella lotta, \PN! Se vuoi, posso curare l'aspetto di uno dei tuoi Pokémon. Potrebbe aiutarlo in lotta.

id: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \bBrock: A quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.
en: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.
it: \bBrock: Oh, va bene allora.

id: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!
en: \bBrock: There!  \v[2] looks a lot better now!
it: \bBrock: Ecco fatto!  \v[2] ha un aspetto molto migliore ora!

id: \bBrock: Hey \PN. You here to support May too?
en: \bBrock: Hey \PN. You here to support May too?
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN. Anche tu qui a fare il tifo per Vera?

id: \bI'm also here for Solidad. She and I both grew up in Pewter City.
en: \bI'm also here for Solidad. She and I both grew up in Pewter City.
it: \bSono qui anche per Solidad. Siamo cresciuti entrambi a Plumbeopoli.

id: \bJames: Welcome to our shop.
en: \bJames: Welcome to our shop.
it: \bJames: Benvenuti nel nostro negozio.

id: \bI only got 7 badges. I decided to come anyways.
en: \bI only got 7 badges. I decided to come anyways.
it: \bHo ottenuto solo 7 medaglie. Ho deciso di venire comunque.

id: \bGary: So I lost in my fourth match. These Trainers are so tough they have to be cheating.
en: \bGary: So I lost in my fourth match. These Trainers are so tough they have to be cheating.
it: \bGary: Ho perso al quarto incontro. Questi Allenatori sono così forti che devono per forza barare.

id: \bI think I'm gonna head back to Pallet Town for now. Good luck in your next match; if I didn't win there's no way you will.\nCatch you later, \PN.
en: \bI think I'm gonna head back to Pallet Town for now.  Good luck in your next match; if I didn't win there's no way you will.\nCatch you later, \PN.
it: \bCredo che per ora tornerò a Biancavilla.  Buona fortuna per il prossimo incontro; se non ho vinto io, non c'è modo che vinca tu.\nCi vediamo, \PN.

id: \bOh right. Your friend is looking for you. He's around here somewhere.
en: \bOh right. Your friend is looking for you. He's around here somewhere.
it: \bAh, giusto. Il tuo amico ti sta cercando. È qui da qualche parte.

id: \rJessie: How can we help you?
en: \rJessie: How can we help you?
it: \rJessie: Come possiamo aiutarti?

id: \bHead south to find some strong Pokémon to fight.
en: \bHead south to find some strong Pokémon to fight.
it: \bVai a sud per trovare Pokémon forti da affrontare.

id: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra losco.\nTu che ne pensi?

id: \rThat shop looks... so empty to me. \nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks... so empty to me. \nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra... così vuoto. \nTu che ne pensi?

id: \bThe Indigo League is done. Come back next year.
en: \bThe Indigo League is done. Come back next year.
it: \bLa Lega Indaco è finita. Torna l'anno prossimo.

id: \rAll these items are good, but they cost so much...
en: \rAll these items are good, but they cost so much...
it: \rQuesti strumenti sono tutti buoni, ma costano così tanto...

id: \rFree Free
en: \rFree Free
it: \rFree Free

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
